body:
User asked (verbatim): "yes do all" (answering: commit the docs, and fix the four library problems as a separate commit?)

Context: found by docs batch B. (1) contrib/otel/otel.go:92 span.RecordError puts the error text with the object key into the exception event even without fsotel.WithKeys; TestSpansCarryNoKeysUnlessAsked checks attributes only. (2) adapters/dropbox Copy/Move delete the destination first, so a failed copy loses the old file. (3) contrib/echo and contrib/fiber pass path parameters still percent-encoded. (4) adapters/gdrive/gdrive.go:26,:101 and adapters/onedrive/onedrive.go:94 (and READMEs) say one chunk in memory; the code holds two.

Acceptance: each fixed at the root with a break-verified test; docs updated to the fixed behaviour; gates green; separate commit after asking.
title: Fix library issues found while documenting: otel key leak, dropbox copy order, echo/fiber path encoding, gdrive/onedrive chunk docs
